summary: Rallybio filed an 8-K reporting that its previously announced merger with Avenzo Therapeutics, under a May 31, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization, will not close as scheduled on November 6, 2026 because conditions tied to post-closing listing of the shares remain unsatisfied. The parties are postponing closing to pursue listing approvals. Consequently, Rallybio did not fund the previously announced cash distribution with Computershare on November 5, 2026, so the distribution's payment and ex-dividend dates may slip. No revised date, price, or board recommendation was disclosed. Watch listing approval timing and distribution mechanics.
